notes.title: Teacup and Kamaeru Team Up in the Froggie Fun Bundle
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We're happy to share that Whitethorn Games has teamed up with Armor Games to create the Froggie Fun Bundle! With this bundle, you'll be able to purchase Teacup along with Karaemu, a frog-collecting game about farming and preserving nature, where you'll collect cute frogs and restore a wetland!

You can pick up the Froggie Fun Steam Bundle starting today and get both games at a 10% discount!
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/51936/Froggie_Fun_Bundle/

We hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: 3-year Anniversary! ♡⸜(｡˃ ᵕ ˂ )⸝尸~~
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

We're happy to commemorate 3 years today since Teacup was released (・ᴗ・)✧

It was our first ever game as a studio and your support has meant everything to us.
 
We've learnt a lot since then to continue improving, so we hope you can continue to stay with us on our journey~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38898389/15b4d35bbfe8e28ae3501a3c8ec1439a224852bc.gif[/img]

notes.title: Minor patch notes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] We fixed the issue where the pop-up for Bubblegum Galaxy appeared multiple times. Thanks to VahidSlayerOfAll and Eon-Rider for the heads up!

notes.title: Happy Anniversary, Teacup!
notes.notes:
It's been a whole year already since Teacup was released... time flies!

Teacup was our first project as a team, and while it's a simple and short game, we're so happy to see that it has brought joy and calmness to so many players. We're grateful to everyone one of you who has played the game and shared your experience with us, and hope to continue working as a team to develop friendly and relaxing experiences.

Haven't tried the game yet? You can pick it up this weekend for 35% off! If you already have, why not gift it to someone you think might enjoy it?

This week we also held a community-led text adventure about Teacup's adventure to the big city over at our [url=discord.smarto.club]Discord.[/url] You can read the path the community chose over at the [i]#teacup-anniversary[/i] channel, but if you want to choose your own path, you can now also [url=twine.smarto.club]play Teacup's Adventure In Girasole City online![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38898389/f4843a47752e39f520e24f98a710dd5531eb416d.png[/img]

notes.title: Teacup is part of Tiny Teams 2022!
notes.notes:
Teacup is part of Tiny Teams 2022! To celebrate, the game will be on sale for the rest of the week. If you're looking for something chill for a chill evening, this is the game for you.
Be sure to check out the main page for the event to find other cool games on sale and with demos! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/tinyteamsfestival]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/tinyteamsfestival[/url]

notes.title: Minor fixes patch
notes.notes: The current update fixes some small issues in the game's text and some scenes.

notes.title: Join the Smarto Club Discord!
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce that we've finally opened a Smarto Club Discord server! If you want to talk about Teacup, be the first to hear more about our upcoming projects [i](*wink*)[/i] or just have a place to share cute animal pictures and wholesome memes, we'd love to have you join us.

You can find the invite by clicking the following picture or by going to [url=discord.smarto.club]discord.smarto.club.[/url]

[url=discord.smarto.club][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38898389/7e55904ff292b6d4d1dd230e6c5642df5ea95e27.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Teacup Steam Trading Cards are now available!
notes.notes:
[i]It's time to go trading...[/i]

The Teacup Steam Trading Cards are now available! Play the game to collect the full set of 5 cards featuring cute pixel art illustrations of Teacup and her friends. We've also added animated avatars, stickers, emoticons and other goodies to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/1444300/]Point Shop,[/url] so check it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38898389/f588da661b0c7a2ff29ac5f7dba583e31aeb635d.png[/img]

notes.title: The Big Adventure Event Returns
notes.notes: Looking for some awesome adventure games to add to your collection? Well, we have some good news for you: The Big Adventure Event (also know as [i]the BAE[/i]) is coming back for 2022. Last year's edition was the first event Teacup ever participated in, and we're glad to be back for this edition [i](Can you spot Teacup in the event key art?).[/i] During the whole event the game will be [b]20% off,[/b] so if you haven't tried it, now's a great moment. We'll be streaming pre-recorded footage from the start of the game and behind-the-scenes development previews during the whole weekend, so check it out!

notes.title: Improved option menu and accessibility fixes
notes.notes: Ever needed to tweak the game's resolution? Or lower the music volume? We've updated the options screen in the main menu so now you can now do this and more. We've also added some accessibility improvements and are working on more, so look forward to them. We hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Teacup available in 5 new languages!
notes.notes:
Better late that never! We're happy to share that in the latest update has added the following languages to the game:
[list]
[*] French
[*] German
[*] Portuguese (Brazil)
[*] Russian
[*] Spanish
[/list]
The game's language can be set via the options screen found in the main menu. We hope you enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38898389/201e7d82925aef3af9ecfafe6cae6f7ebb212442.png[/img]

notes.title: Teacup x Makeship: Check out this froggy plush!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
Ever felt lonely while drinking a cup of tea? Well, no need to worry about that any more, because the Teacup plush is here! With her trusty tea book, a cup of tea and a cute little backpack, this little frog is equally ready for an adventure or a chill afternoon of tea sipping at home.

[h3]Check out the campaign![/h3]
Want one? The plush will be available for a limited time only, so be sure [url=https://shop.makeship.com/309RXtL]to head over to Makeship and get yours[/url] before they’re gone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38898389/bd5e7e638095c936fb4b74a58aefa25b75eb4723.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Teacup is available now in Chinese!
notes.notes:
We're very happy to share that thanks to our partners at Whisper Games Teacup is now available in Chinese! The language can be changed in the new Options menu found in the main menu in the latest update. We hope you enjoy it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38898389/0e4246a31f229d50ef56745dab7e2414cc0af18d.png[/img]

notes.title: Teacup available now on Nintendo Switch!
notes.notes:
Looking for something to curl up on the couch with and relax this evening? We're happy to share that Teacup is now available on Nintendo Switch, so now you're free to Teacup on her journey for tea and visit Little Pond from wherever you please. We hope to see you at the tea party!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38898389/c94f73ce925b37014f28c72eb33ce0c36aa30f90.png[/img]

notes.title: Teacup Illustration Stream!
notes.notes: Want to watch our environment artist draw Teacup in her own unique style? Join us on Monday at 13:00 PST for a relaxing stream where we will chat and draw all our troubles away.

notes.title: Behind The Tea
notes.notes: Interested in game development? Wondered how a game is built behind the scenes? Join the team this Sunday at 9:00AM PST to learn more about how Teacup was made! Our main programmer will be playing the game and talking about different technical aspects, and might even show how the game looks like in its development enviroment!

notes.title: Teacup Comic Stream!
notes.notes: Have you ever wondered what Teacup would look like if it were a comic instead of game? Well, you'll be able to find out for yourself this Saturday at 9:00AM PST! Our character artist will be drawing a short comic following the adventures of Teacup in Little Pond while the rest of the team chats. We hope to see you there!

notes.title: Join us during LudoNarraCon for a Q&A!
notes.notes:
You might have seen it already on our social media or mailing list, but if not, we're happy to announce we'll be part of [b]LudoNarraCon[/b], a digital convention celebrating narrative video games, starting [b]tomorrow![/b]
Besides a chance to try Teacup's demo if you haven't already, we have a lot of fun events and streams lined up, like tomorrow's Q&A! It will be held at [b]13:00 PST[/b] over at the [url=http://discord.gg/fellowtraveller ]Fellow Traveller Discord,[/url] so make sure to join if you want to ask us anything about the game or anything else! We hope to see you there 🐸

notes.title: Teacup Art and Chat Stream
notes.notes:
Hey! Ever wanted to see one of our artist at work? Well, you'll be able to this [b]Friday at 11AM PST![/b] The character artist for Teacup will be doing Teacup related drawing and doodles while we chat about the game and life in general. It's going to be fun, so make sure to tune in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38898389/e8a1cf490c33056cc6a689ece7923d212d95fecc.gif[/img]

notes.title: Watch us play the Teacup demo at 11AM PST!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We'll be participating in the upcoming Steam Game Festival showing off Teacup's demo, and you can watch us play it at [b]11AM PST on Wednesday,[/b] the day the festival starts. We'll be talking about the creative decisions behind the game and answering any questions you may have.

We hope you look forward to it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38898389/2d28b07b6561b56aa1ef8d45e145af8c47ceeedb.png[/img]

notes.title: Play Teacup's first public demo during The Big Adventure Event!
notes.notes:
We're glad to announce Teacup will be part of the first ever [b]"Big Adventure Event"[/b] presented by Hitcents starting January 21st! Besides being a great chance to discover new adventure games, you'll be able to play the [b]first ever public demo[/b] of Teacup. We'll also be streaming gameplay and other goodies, including a live Q&A on Saturday 23rd at 2PM GTM. 
We hope you look forward to it!
